integrity: The proof separates prior-covered visibility-polynomial computation from the new extremal comparison. It derives two decisive coefficients directly from the mutual-visibility definition and proves the exact maximum class and the threshold for nonexistence of a coefficientwise minimum. A separate definition-level checker verifies the full coefficient formula before testing the extremal statements.
scientific_limitations: The coefficientwise extremal theorem is restricted to connected noncomplete complete multipartite graphs of fixed order.
The underlying complete-multipartite coefficient formula is compatible with and partly derivable from published join formulas; the new claim is the cross-partition extremal classification.
Definition-level exhaustive verification is finite and runs through order ten; partition-level extremal checks run through order thirty.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed coefficientwise extremal theorem.
title: Coefficientwise extremals for visibility polynomials of complete multipartite graphs
